notes.title: Version 0.8.9b update
notes.content: [p]Version 0.8.9b update[/p][p]1. Layout fine-tuning, better suited for players with fish screens;[/p][p]2. Restoration of historical events related to the use of the same script in the Qin Dynasty;[/p][p]3. Correct the description of "White Tiger" in the collection;[/p][p]4. Font enlargement, correction of missing fonts;[/p][p]5. Adding annotations to the hexagram cards can help with understanding a bit;[/p][p]6. Other optimizations, etc.[/p]

notes.title: 0.8.9 Version Update Description
notes.content: [p]0.8.9 Version Update Description[/p][p]1. Fixed the bug of mountain peeling;[/p][p]2. Lock the frame rate limit to 100 frames per second to reduce occupancy;[/p][p]3. Fixed the small red dot on the main menu;[/p][p]4. Other optimizations.[/p]

notes.title: 2025.7.16 Update Description
notes.content: [p]2025.7.16 Update Description[/p][p]1. DEMO v 0.3.1 version update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170962/3cb84a33fe0d86928c259d254e620660b5620a21.png[/img]
Update Description:
1. This DEMO update is a free beta version, with the main purpose of inviting players to test first, identify various strange bugs to fix, and better optimize the player experience!
2. If you encounter any bugs, welcome players to enter our player QQ group: 762116255 and give us feedback!
Update content:
1. All 8 talents of the character card have been launched, including appearance, virtue, wisdom, temperament, strength, emptiness, wealth, and fortune; After the first level talent is promoted, there are more powerful second level talents: Qingcheng, Junzi, Wolong, Mount Taishan, Bawang, eminent monk, Tao Zhu, Tianyou; The promotion method is "First level Talent"+corresponding "Four Symbols Mark";
2. All 28 constellations have been launched and have been fully installed with illustrations;
3. The sixty-four hexagrams have already been implemented in 63 hexagrams, with only one hexagram not yet implemented;
4. The imprints of the Four Symbols of Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, and Xuanwu are all fully implemented, as well as the four immortal Taoist methods of human, earth, heaven, and Taoism;
5. Twelve Golden Immortal Card Skill Implementation, Tachibana has not been updated yet!
6. Twelve Zodiac Signs Updated!
7. The Big Dipper is fully equipped with two states: Greedy Wolf, Giant Gate, Lucun, Wenqu, Lianzhen, Wuqu, and Broken Army. Players can purchase the 'Seven Star Treasure Box' in the store to draw!
8. The levels of this experience include 8 historical events of the Xia Dynasty!
9. There are countless updates and optimizations on various other experiences, please experience them!
